description: Use to see the Watch + Alert watches started with your RugRadar credit key (api_key or header X-RugRadar-Key): watchId, token, status (active, expired, cancelled), expiry, destination and alert count, newest first. Read-only and free: it never spends a credit or starts a check. Only watches paid with that same credit key are listed; watches paid per-call with x402 are not tied to a key and do not appear (use the watchId and secret you got back for those). To start a watch use watch_token; to stop one use cancel_watch.

api_key.description: RugRadar credit key used to start the watches (or header X-RugRadar-Key)

name: list_watches

outputSchema.description: Success fields on a paid/authorized call, or error/payment_required fields. Additional properties may be present.

error.description: payment_required, bad_input, or a failure code

payWith.description: x402 payment requirement for the HTTP route, plus credit-key instructions when those apply

priceUsd.description: USDC price to pay when error is payment_required

refunded.description: true when a credit was taken and then returned because the call failed

title: List My Token Watches
